questions.question_english: A Principal discovers that several teachers are struggling to integrate IT tools into their daily teaching due to 'technophobia.' As an instructional leader, what is the best approach to mitigate this?
options_english: Formally issue show-cause administrative notices to all teaching staff who fail to adopt mandatory ICT tools.
Completely dismantle and withdraw classroom IT installations, reverting exclusively to chalk-and-talk teaching.
Outsource all classroom IT integration tasks to external commercial vendors and permanently relieve staff of digital duties.
Provide continuous professional development and peer mentoring in a supportive setting.
questions.explanation_english: Overcoming technology anxiety among teaching staff requires supportive instructional leadership, structured continuous professional development, and peer mentoring programs. Punitive administrative actions or complete outsourcing fail to develop internal capacity, whereas incremental skill-building fosters positive attitudes toward integrating modern technology into daily administrative and pedagogical practices.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Provide continuous professional development and peer mentoring in a supportive setting.

questions.question_english: What is the primary function of a 'Captive Portal' in a school's Wi-Fi network?
options_english: To automatically capture facial photographs of students and staff entering the computer laboratory facility
To permanently isolate and trap incoming network malware threats within an isolated software sandbox
To require user authentication or agreement to policies before accessing the internet.
To serve as a high-capacity offline network storage device for archiving pre-recorded classroom video lectures
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that a captive portal requires user authentication or agreement to policies before accessing the internet. A captive portal is a specialized network web page that intercepts wireless network traffic, requiring users to authenticate credentials or accept terms of service before accessing the broader internet. In school Wi-Fi environments, captive portals manage guest connections, track network usage, restrict unauthorized access, and ensure compliance with institutional acceptable use internet policies.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। कैप्टिव पोर्टल का कार्य उपयोगकर्ता प्रमाणीकरण या नीतियों से सहमति की आवश्यकता करना है। यह एक विशेष नेटवर्क वेब पृष्ठ है जो वायरलेस नेटवर्क ट्रैफ़िक को अवरुद्ध करता है, उपयोगकर्ताओं को व्यापक इंटरनेट तक पहुँचने से पहले प्रमाणीकरण क्रेडेंशियल्स या सेवा की शर्तों को स्वीकार करने की आवश्यकता होती है। स्कूल के वाई-फाई वातावरण में, कैप्टिव पोर्टल मेहमान कनेक्शनों का प्रबंधन करता है, नेटवर्क उपयोग को ट्रैक करता है, अनधिकृत पहुँच को प्रतिबंधित करता है, और संस्थागत स्वीकार्य उपयोग इंटरनेट नीतियों के अनुपालन को सुनिश्चित करता है।
